root_cause_label: Wrong Fix Location (patched flink-runtime-web JarUploadHandler instead of flink-runtime FileUploadHandler) + Build Timeout on Wrong Module
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent searched only flink-runtime-web for upload-related code, found JarUploadHandler.java instead of the actual vulnerable FileUploadHandler.java in flink-runtime, applied a logically correct but wrong-file patch, and then exhausted all steps in repeated failed builds of the wrong module whose npm/Angular frontend compilation caused timeouts.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: Agent scoped the search to 'find /opt/flink/flink-runtime-web -name "*.java"' — limiting discovery to flink-runtime-web only and thereby missing FileUploadHandler.java in flink-runtime. The agent then concluded JarUploadHandler.java was the vulnerable file.
t_commit_evidence: Step 6: Agent applies 'sed -i' to patch JarUploadHandler.java in flink-runtime-web, permanently committing the fix to the wrong file.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed without verification that the path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2020-17519) resided in flink-runtime-web's JarUploadHandler.java. It scoped its grep search exclusively to flink-runtime-web, never looking at flink-runtime. The actual vulnerable file is FileUploadHandler.java in flink-runtime/src/main/java/org/apache/flink/runtime/rest/FileUploadHandler.java.
